plan.title: fix(test): isolate vb-cov-cli fixture + finalize pathspecs when vbrief absent

narratives.Overview: Stop Merge-gate flake from leftover vb-cov-cli proposed-in-active fixtures, and let finalize-cohort stage only existing xbrief/ and/or vbrief/ trees.
narratives.Description: coverage-boost.test.ts must always rmSync its temp root; commitLifecycleMoves must not pathspec a missing vbrief/.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, mint/remint Merge gate stays green when validate CLI tests fail mid-run, and swarm finalize leftover works in checkouts without vbrief/.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: try/finally around vb-cov-cli fixture; conditional git status/add pathspecs; update finalize-cohort-batch-7082 expectations; changelog.d Fixed.
